GALLERY — PRINT

On paper.

Some work lives on a screen. This work lives in the hand — a proposal a client thumbs through at the table, a letterhead that arrives in the post, a business card handed over after a handshake. Print is still the first thing people hold, so I design it like it matters — because it does.

CLIENTVarious
WHAT I DIDPrint design
YEAR2015–2025
PLATFORMPrint
01 / PROPOSALS

The proposal, printed.

TeckBasket — an IT services proposal, designed as a document a client actually wants to pick up: a bold cover, a human About Us, and the process laid out so it reads at a glance.

02 / LETTERHEAD

Every letter, on brand.

A letterhead is the smallest brand surface there is — and the one that lands on a desk. This one carries the ZK Talk Digital mark, the colours, and nothing it doesn’t need.

03 / BUSINESS CARDS

One card, three ways.

Lending Careers — Bob Catalina, VP National Recruiting. The same navy-and-orange mark, three front-and-back pairings, so he could pick the one that felt right in the hand.

04 / FLYERS

One night, one poster.

A party flyer has one job: make the night feel unmissable. Big type, a face, a date — and nothing else fighting for attention.

05 / INFOGRAPHIC

Ten reasons, top to bottom.

A long read made short: why most startups fail, one illustrated reason at a time. Made to be scrolled — or pinned to a wall.
